correctness.rationale: Exact contact reduction to the doubled triangular torus is proved. The even-order case follows from the cited abelian Cayley 1-factorization. The odd-order case follows from the all-odd-subset bounds e(S)<=s(s-1)/2 for s=3,5; <=17 for s=7; <=3s-1 for s=9,11; and <=3s for s>=13, together with Goldberg–Seymour and the odd full-set counting lower bound. m,n>=5 ensures the simple local hexagon. A standalone 5x5 certificate checker passed on the actual 150-tile geometry, verifying all 1575 contacts. Finite checks do not prove the general theorem.

value.rationale: The extremal 21-contact convex monohedral tiling is a motivated canonical object. The theorem classifies the exact palette for every rectangular toroidal compactification with periods >=5 and shows a sharp one-color parity transition, with a fully independent 5x5 balanced coloring witness. A uniform all-period classification and conceptual matching obstruction are substantively more meaningful than an arbitrary finite graph coloring count.
